# CSOAI - Council Safety of AI
The sovereign AI governance OS. Build your own AI, own your data, govern it. Free open-source base; full managed stack on Pro.
## Pages
- Start free: https://os.csoai.org/start
- Sov Space: https://os.csoai.org/sov-space
- Governance Graph: https://os.csoai.org/graph
- Plans: https://os.csoai.org/plans
- Status: https://os.csoai.org/status
- Framework Hive (everything collected per framework): https://os.csoai.org/hive
- Signed AI System Card (issue, verify offline, tamper rejected): https://os.csoai.org/system-card
- Personal Protection (deepfake/impersonation shield): https://os.csoai.org/protect
- The Ontology (objects, links, actions): https://os.csoai.org/ontology
- Safe Space (all AI governance, crosswalked): https://os.csoai.org/safe-space
- Live demo & tour (auto, voice): https://os.csoai.org/demo
- BFT Council: https://os.csoai.org/try
- Public AI Watchdog: https://os.csoai.org/watchdog-map
## For agents
Full rundown for inspection/testing: AGENTS.md in the repo. Live reasoning + signing API: https://os.meok.ai/api (/chat, /govern, /orchestrate, /health, /systemcard, /sign, /verify — keyless, verify offline). 30+ open-source governed MCP tools at github.com/CSOAI-ORG.
## Org
CSOAI Ltd (UK). MIT-licensed core. EU AI Act Article 50 transparent.
